html:
Setthathirath was king of Lan Xang from 1548 to about 1571, and for a time also king of Lan Na. He moved the Lao capital from Luang Prabang to Vientiane in 1560.

He brought the Emerald Buddha from Chiang Mai to Vientiane, and built Pha That Luang and Wat Xieng Thong. The move south put the capital closer to the rice plains and further from the armies of Burma.

He fought off the Burmese king Bayinnaung, who took Vientiane for a time, and disappeared on a campaign in the south around 1571. The Emerald Buddha stayed in Vientiane until Siam took it in 1779; it now sits in Wat Phra Kaew in Bangkok.
